BiblicalUsage: Japho is the old name of Joppa, the port on the sea where cedar from Lebanon came ashore. Solomon's timber floated down to Joppa and was carried up to Jerusalem, and after the exile the same port received cedar for the second temple by the grant of Cyrus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God brings His timber by sea, and the same harbour served the first temple and the second.
